source_title: Motorola confirms the Signature 27's exact launch date - GSMArena.com news - GSMArena.com
source_excerpt:
Motorola first showed off the Signature 27 during Qualcomm's Snapdragon Summit back in September , but it's been holding back the full specs and pricing ever since. Yesterday, its Indian website said the phone is "coming this November" , and now the company has narrowed that down to an exact date: November 5.
Here's what we already know. The Signature 27 is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset, cooled by an ArcticMesh system with a vapor chamber that's 40% larger than the previous generation's.
There's a 50MP Sony Lytia 910 main camera with OIS and a 200MP periscope telephoto, plus Audio by Bang & Olufsen . It runs Android 17 out of the box and comes with a promise of seven years of OS updates. The rest of the camera setup still hasn't been detailed, and there do seem to be a lot of cameras in its gigantic camera bump, so we're definitely intrigued, to say the least. Price-wise, a recent retailer listing from Europe confirms that this won't be an affordable device.
